notes.title: Update 1.1.0.0
notes.notes:
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards. There is now a leaderboard per level. Best times have been reset due to some patches. You'll need to complete a level to get a leaderboard entry.
[/list]

[b]Undocumented Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Security doors weren't closing on certain death events
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.2
notes.notes:
Leaderboards are having some issues. Still looking into this.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an ini option to show what level you're on
[*] Add a sound effect when you beat your best time
[*] Gamepad bumpers now work in the level select screen
[/list]

[b]Undocumented Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a timer to the Pause menu to stop (or slow down) a jump glitch
[*] Left thumbstick now works on the menus
[/list]

notes.title: IZBOT 2 is available now!
notes.notes:
The little robot is back zipping all over the place. Help defeat the evil Bedlor once more.

80 levels, 4 bosses and a truckload of spikes. 

Special launch discount and launch pricing for the early adopters!

notes.title: IZBOT2 Feb Release
notes.notes:
So things haven't quite moved as quickly as I have hoped.

I'm going to postpone the release of IZBOT2 to Feb to allow for some more time to work on some features.

Apologies for the delays. It will be worth the wait!

notes.title: IZBOT2 Demo out now!
notes.notes:
Our beloved pint sized hero is back!

The organic invasion has been defeated but Bedlor has managed to infiltrate the city's defence systems and turn them against IZBOT and the peace loving robots.

The IZBOT2 demo is a 15 level preview of the upcoming game which features IZBOT's new dashing ability (as well as a lot of pointy spikes). Download and wish list now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1452790/IZBOT_2/
